# Eventaj.si - Photo Booth & 360° Booth Rental Services

## About Our Business

Eventaj.si is Slovenia's premier Photo Booth rental service, specializing in professional Photo Booth and 360° Booth experiences for events, weddings, parties, and celebrations across Slovenia.

## Our Services

### Photo Booth Rental (Photo Booth & Foto Stojnica)
- **Starting Price**: 279€ for 2 hours
- **Features**: Unlimited photos, instant printing, digital copies, props included, personalization options, online gallery
- **Perfect For**: Weddings, corporate events, parties, celebrations
- **Packages**: Basic (2h/279€), Standard (3h/329€), Premium (4h/379€)

### 360° Booth Rental
- **Starting Price**: 299€ for 2 hours
- **Features**: 360-degree slow motion videos, QR code sharing, AirDrop sharing, digital frames, props included
- **Perfect For**: TikTok content, Instagram reels, viral social media content, modern events
- **Packages**: Mini (2h/299€), Basic (3h/349€), Maxi (4h/399€)

### Foto Kotiček (Photo Corner)
- **Starting Price**: 279€ for 2 hours
- **Features**: Unlimited printing, funny props, digital copies, perfect for birthday parties
- **Perfect For**: Birthday parties, smaller events, intimate celebrations

## Service Area

- **Primary Coverage**: Slovenia (po Sloveniji)
- **Major Cities**: Ljubljana, Maribor, Celje, Kranj, Koper, Novo mesto, Ptuj
- **Regional Focus**: Štajerska, Gorenjska, Dolenjska, Primorska, Prekmurje
- **Service Radius**: 20km brezplačno iz Lenarta v Slovenskih goricah (plačljiv prevoz za ostalo Slovenijo)
- **Free Transportation**: Included up to 20km; beyond that we quote transparent travel fees
- **Headquarters**: Slomškova ulica 1, 2230 Lenart v Slovenskih goricah

## Event equipment and personalized products

- [Standing cocktail tables](https://www.eventaj.si/oprema-za-dogodke/najem-stojecih-miz): €10 per table per day, white or black tablecloth included, up to 15 tables.
- [Welcome sign](https://www.eventaj.si/oprema-za-dogodke/tabla-dobrodoslice): rental from €29 or personalized purchase from €59, stand included with rental.
- [Table numbers](https://www.eventaj.si/oprema-za-dogodke/stevilke-miz): acrylic numbers with stands, rental from €1.90 per table.
- [Place names](https://www.eventaj.si/oprema-za-dogodke/imena-za-na-kroznik): personalized white or natural wood names from €1.90 each, minimum 40.
- [Guest book frame](https://www.eventaj.si/oprema-za-dogodke/knjiga-gostov-v-okvirju): personalized heart or tree design, €175 with 150 wooden pieces or €200 with 200 pieces.
- [Wedding puzzle](https://www.eventaj.si/oprema-za-dogodke/porocni-puzzle): personalized wooden signing puzzle with names and date, €200 for 90 pieces or €250 for 160 pieces.
- [Event games](https://www.eventaj.si/oprema-za-dogodke/igre-za-dogodke): wooden games for weddings and company events, four-game package from €149.
- [Beer pong table](https://www.eventaj.si/oprema-za-dogodke/beer-pong-miza): wedding or LED version for €49 per day; personalization is not available and transport is charged separately.
- [Guest fans](https://www.eventaj.si/oprema-za-dogodke/pahljace-za-goste): personalized double-sided printed fans, €3 each for 50–99 pieces, €2.50 each for 100–199 pieces, and €2 each from 200 pieces; minimum 50 pieces.

The product category is available at https://www.eventaj.si/oprema-za-dogodke. Welcome signs, wedding puzzles, guest book frames, table numbers, place names, and guest fans can be shipped by post; postage is always charged separately. Standing tables, event games, and beer pong tables require transport to the venue, charged separately at €0.40/km up to 75 km. Rental stock depends on the event date. Personalized products require production time, which is stated on each product page.
